fields.note: P2's cold edge is the inherited 037b/048 bond-interface screen (Be/Al CTE mismatch from the 200 F cure): outer-skin minimum >= 264.03 K. It is not validated by cold assembled-interface tests (050 NFI50-05). It applies on the ground as well as in flight: a moored hull also needs cover, heating or a low-emittance finish on cold clear nights.
